image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) displayed on a black mannequin torso. The armor features intricate vertical etched patterns down the center and sides, a raised central ridge, and a horizontal slit near the neck opening. The surface is highly reflective, showing light glints and shadows that emphasize its curved, anatomical shape. A portion of the lower abdominal armor (fauld) is visible at the bottom.
